name.en-US: The Steps of Humility and Pride
name.pt-BR: Os graus da humildade e da soberba

description.la: Tractatus Bernardi ad Godefridum de gradibus humilitatis et superbiae: duodecim humilitatis gradus ad veritatem, duodecim superbiae ad curiositatem et inde ad consuetudinem peccandi.
description.en-US: Bernard’s first treatise, written for his cousin Godfrey: the twelve steps of humility by which one climbs to truth, and the twelve of pride by which one falls from curiosity to the habit of sin, with Mabillon’s admonitio. Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O primeiro tratado de Bernardo, escrito para seu primo Godofredo: os doze graus da humildade que levam à verdade e os doze da soberba que levam da curiosidade ao hábito do pecado.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), work 6156, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with Mabillon’s admonitio, chapter headings and summaries. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
